paraphrase: In his early twenties, working on 'wu' at Eiganji, Hakuin fell into great doubt as if frozen in ice for days; at the distant sound of the temple bell it shattered and he thought no one had awakened like him in three hundred years; Shōju Rōjin crushed this pride and he practised on, with later awakenings.
speaker: Hakuin
notes: From memory; the text is not held locally, so no original is quoted and section labels are descriptive.
